fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our 2020 fuel consumption, a hypothetical ten percent increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased fuel expense by approximately $21.8 million for the 2020 year.

instrument_type_details.notes: Company states 'have not hedged fuel price risk in many years'.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed (thousands) ... 149,479 [from 2022 Annual Report operating statistics table, four-year comparison]; Aircraft fuel expense decreased $206.0 million, or 48.2 percent in 2020 compared to 2019. System fuel gallons consumed decreased by 23.9 percent.

warnings: COVID-19 significantly reduced FY2020 fuel consumption; 10% sensitivity of $21.8M is substantially lower than prior years
